summary: LPA, a NYSE American-listed Latin American logistics REIT, announced the sale of Bodegas Aurora, a stabilized non-core industrial property in Heredia, Costa Rica, for a US$6.6 million gross purchase price in an all-cash direct asset transfer. The two-building, 103,440-square-foot multi-tenant asset generates roughly US$560,000 of annual net operating income, implying a ~8.5% cap rate. Closing is expected in Q4 2026, subject to confirmatory due diligence and customary conditions, following the pending Peru sale. Proceeds will fund Mexican expansion. Watch diligence slippage and redeployment timing.
